sn22.145:1.2: “Monks, whatever is not-self, you should abandon desire-passion there. And what is not-self? “Form, monks, is not-self. You should abandon desire-passion there. “Feeling is not-self. You should abandon desire-passion there. “Perception is not-self. You should abandon desire-passion there. “Fabrications are not-self. You should abandon desire-passion there. “Consciousness is not-self. You should abandon desire-passion there. “Monks, whatever is not-self, you should abandon desire-passion there.”
